name: Elias Crowe
text: Your father is up north, somewhere under the snow. Dead or alive, we'll find him.

name: Elias Crowe
text: Your father and I came to these woods the same winter. We were both seventeen, and both fools.
read: Your father and I came to these woods the same winter. We were both seventeen, and both fools.

name: Elias Crowe
text: Our first winter a wolf pack surrounded our camp. Abel grabbed a log from the fire and yelled. The wolves ran.

text: My father? Yelled?

name: Elias Crowe
text: Once. Then he didn't raise his voice for twenty years.

name: Elias Crowe
text: ...Shh. Hear that?

name: Elias Crowe
text: The Old King. Standing up he's two men tall. His left ear is torn, a trapper's keepsake.
read: The Old King. Standing up he's two men tall. His left ear is torn, a trapper's keepsake.

name: Elias Crowe
text: You won't drop him with one shot. Shoot from range, fall back, shoot again. Run and he'll run you down.
read: You won't drop him with one shot. Shoot from range, fall back, shoot again. Run and he'll run you down.

name: Elias Crowe
text: When a bear guards a place, it's guarding either its food or its enemy. Pray it's the second.

name: Abel (baba / father)
text: Six weeks. Every night I waited, I thought the same thing: "The kid can't read tracks."
